name: backstage-jev-operations-support
description: Six decision workflows for Backstage, powered by TypeSafe Jev

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace plugins/jev-operations-support-common --workspace plugins/jev-operations-support-backend --workspace plugins/jev-operations-support --workspace plugins/jev-operations-support-tech-insights --workspace plugins/jev-operations-support-aws-notifications
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run build:demo
scripts.pack:plugins: npm run build && mkdir -p dist/packages && npm pack --workspaces --pack-destination dist/packages
